entries.name: gpe_rt.metallib
entries.role: GPU driver support shaders for Apple silicon / Apple GL-over-Metal
entries.note: Apple GPU driver internals (AGX family, GL shim); BifrOSt gets GPU drivers from Mesa/Vulkan (springboard/gpu) so there is no equivalent and no app depends on it

entries.name: ImageFilters.metallib
entries.role: Computer-vision, computational photography or ML image processing shaders
entries.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/image_kernels.rs (convolve, source_over, histogram); springboard/src/gpu/filter_kernels.rs; springboard/render/src/kernel_vision.rs; springboard/render/src/kernel_photo_adjust.rs; springboard/gpu/shaders/photo_adjust.comp
entries.note: Classical image-analysis kernels (edges, corners, thresholds, template match, text bands, saliency) now exist on the CPU in kernel_vision.rs. Learned models (recognition, detection) need trained weights that BifrOSt does not ship; this row covers the pixel kernels only. Photo adjustment kernels now cover both per-pixel colour (colorfx.rs, photo_effects.rs) and neighbourhood operations (kernel_photo_adjust.rs). The GLSL file is compiled by gpu/build.rs but no pipeline dispatches it yet.
entries.ready_note: Ready: classical computer-vision kernels in springboard/render/src/kernel_vision.rs (Sobel, Canny with non-maximum suppression and hysteresis, Harris corners, Otsu and Sauvola thresholds, summed-area tables, normalised cross-correlation template matching, text-line bands, centre-surround saliency and salient box), tests kernel_vision::tests. No trained model is involved or shipped; no GLSL file was written. Clean-room: written from public algorithm descriptions for the job this library serves; the metallib was not disassembled or compared. Also: spatial photo adjustments in springboard/render/src/kernel_photo_adjust.rs (box blur, unsharp mask with threshold, midtone-weighted clarity, bilateral denoise, percentile auto levels, dark-channel dehaze), tests kernel_photo_adjust::tests; per-pixel colour adjustments stay in colorfx.rs, color_curve.rs, edge_tone_filters.rs and photo_effects.rs; GLSL twin of the unsharp and clarity apply pass in springboard/gpu/shaders/photo_adjust.comp (not wired to a pipeline). Clean-room: written from public algorithm descriptions for the job this library serves; the metallib was not disassembled or compared.

entries.name: Gess_Kernels.metallib
entries.role: 3D scene / RealityKit / USD rendering and geometry processing shaders
entries.note: BifrOSt has 3D models (springboard/ui/src/scene3d.rs, scene_material.rs, mesh.rs, particle_system3d.rs) that draw nothing, and no 3D rasteriser or PBR shader; needed for 3D previews (Quick Look USD) and any 3D app. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled
entries.ready_note: Ready: rectified-stereo block-matching disparity (SAD over shifted windows) in springboard/render/src/stereo.rs, tests stereo::tests. This is the matching kernel only, not a photogrammetry pipeline; no GLSL file was written.

entries.name: harpe.metallib
entries.role: 3D scene / RealityKit / USD rendering and geometry processing shaders
entries.note: Materials, lights and mesh layout exist as models, but no GPU rasteriser or physically based shader draws them yet.
entries.ready_note: Ready: the PBR material shading function in springboard/render/src/pbr.rs (GGX, Smith, Schlick Fresnel, metallic/roughness), tests pbr::tests. The per-point piece only; no GPU rasteriser or GLSL shader was added.

entries.name: harpe_mtlx_base.metallib
entries.role: 3D scene / RealityKit / USD rendering and geometry processing shaders
entries.note: A MaterialX node library needs a material graph compiler, which BifrOSt does not have.

entries.name: harpe_mtlx_lib_0.metallib
entries.role: 3D scene / RealityKit / USD rendering and geometry processing shaders
entries.note: A material-graph node subset and a scalar graph-to-GLSL compiler now exist in kernel_materialx.rs on top of shading_graph.rs and pbr.rs. The full node library (vector and colour graphs, standard surface, image nodes) is not implemented.
entries.ready_note: Ready (node subset and compiler): material-graph node library and graph compiler in springboard/render/src/kernel_materialx.rs (gradient and fractal noise, cellular noise, ramps, split, checkerboard, remap, contrast, HSV conversion, 2-D placement, normal-map node; ShaderGraph with CPU evaluation and GLSL code generation including a noise prelude that matches the CPU hash), tests kernel_materialx::tests. The simpler evaluator is shading_graph.rs; surface shading is pbr.rs. Only a subset of the standard node library is implemented, with scalar graphs; no GLSL shader file was added because the compiler emits GLSL at run time. Clean-room: written from public algorithm descriptions for the job this library serves; the metallib was not disassembled or compared.

entries.name: harpe_mtlx_lib_1.metallib
entries.role: 3D scene / RealityKit / USD rendering and geometry processing shaders
entries.note: Materials are ordered named properties with a shading model; there is no shading graph compiler, so graph shaders are not generated.
entries.ready_note: Ready: a validated scalar shading-graph evaluator (constant, input, add, multiply, mix, clamp nodes) in springboard/render/src/shading_graph.rs, tests shading_graph::tests. It is the smallest piece of a material graph compiler; no MaterialX parser or GLSL output was written.

entries.name: harpe_mtlx_lib_2.metallib
entries.role: 3D scene / RealityKit / USD rendering and geometry processing shaders
entries.note: A MaterialX node library needs a material graph compiler, which BifrOSt does not have.
